meta.note: Internal device data is synthetic, not real network assets. Register offsets and clause numbers marked pending are listed in knowledge_graph.json -> pending_confirmations.

fields.name: 模块标识符
fields.description: 封装/模块类型标识，编码由 SFF-8024 定义；0x18=QSFP-DD、0x19=OSFP 等取值待与当前版本编码表复核
fields.description_en: Form-factor identifier defined by SFF-8024 (e.g. 0x18 QSFP-DD, 0x19 OSFP); codes pending review

fields.name: CMIS 版本
fields.description: 模块声明的 CMIS 修订版本，例如 0x52=5.2、0x53=5.3、0x54=5.4
fields.description_en: Revision Compliance byte; 0x52=5.2, 0x53=5.3, 0x54=5.4 (nibble encoding pending review)

fields.name: 模块状态
fields.description: 模块状态机当前状态（ModuleLowPwr / ModulePwrUp / ModuleReady / ModuleFault 等）
fields.description_en: Current Module State Machine state (ModuleLowPwr / ModulePwrUp / ModuleReady / ModuleFault)

fields.name: 模块级标志汇总
fields.description: Lower 8-13 的模块级标志；部分位为 Clear-on-Read，读取本身有副作用
fields.description_en: Lower 8-13 module-level flags; some bits are Clear-on-Read, so reads have side effects

fields.name: 通道标志汇总
fields.description: Pages 10h-1Fh 各通道标志的汇总字节
fields.description_en: Summary of lane flags from pages 10h-1Fh

fields.name: 厂商名称
fields.description: Upper Page 00h 的 16 字节 ASCII 厂商名；精确偏移待 OIF 原文核对
fields.description_en: 16-byte ASCII vendor name in Upper Page 00h; exact offset pending

fields.name: 厂商 OUI
fields.description: 3 字节 IEEE 公司 ID
fields.description_en: 3-byte IEEE company ID

fields.name: 厂商料号
fields.description: 16 字节 ASCII 料号，偏移待核对
fields.description_en: 16-byte ASCII part number, offset pending

fields.name: 序列号
fields.description: 16 字节 ASCII 序列号，偏移待核对
fields.description_en: 16-byte ASCII serial number, offset pending

fields.name: 日期码
fields.description: 生产日期码
fields.description_en: Manufacturing date code

fields.name: CC_BASE 校验和
fields.description: 基础 ID 块校验和；重编码 EEPROM 后必须重算
fields.description_en: Checksum of the base ID block; must be recomputed after re-coding

fields.name: CC_EXT 校验和
fields.description: 扩展 ID 块校验和
fields.description_en: Checksum of the extended ID block

fields.name: 模块类型编码
fields.description: 区分可插拔光模块/铜缆/有源光缆
fields.description_en: Distinguishes pluggable optics, copper cables and active optical cables

fields.name: Host 电接口 ID
fields.description: Application Descriptor 第 1 字节：Host Electrical Interface ID，编码见 SFF-8024
fields.description_en: First byte of an Application Descriptor; codes defined by SFF-8024

fields.name: Media 光接口 ID
fields.description: Application Descriptor 第 2 字节：Media Interface ID
fields.description_en: Second byte of an Application Descriptor

fields.name: Host/Media Lane 数
fields.description: 高 4 bit 为 Host lane 数、低 4 bit 为 Media lane 数；0x88 = 8 host / 8 media
fields.description_en: Upper nibble = host lane count, lower nibble = media lane count

fields.name: Host Lane 分配选项
fields.description: 允许的首 Host lane 位图
fields.description_en: Bitmap of allowed first host lanes

fields.name: 模块全局控制
fields.description: Lower 26-30，含 LowPwrRequestSW 等模块级控制位；远程写被安全策略拒绝
fields.description_en: Lower 26-30 including LowPwrRequestSW; remote writes are blocked by the safety policy

fields.name: 模块级标志掩码
fields.description: Lower 31-36 的标志屏蔽位
fields.description_en: Lower 31-36 masking bits for module-level flags

fields.name: 活动固件版本
fields.description: Lower 39-40 活动固件版本
fields.description_en: Lower 39-40 active firmware version

fields.name: 非活动固件版本
fields.description: 00h 表示仅支持单镜像
fields.description_en: 00h indicates a single-image module

fields.name: CDB 状态区
fields.description: 最近一次 CDB 命令的状态位；命令执行后需轮询
fields.description_en: Status of the most recently triggered CDB command; poll after triggering

fields.name: 应用通告（旧布局）
fields.description: CMIS 4.x 低页应用通告；5.3/5.4 主要使用 Upper Page 01h 应用描述符，此偏移标注待确认
fields.description_en: CMIS 4.x lower-memory advertising; 5.3/5.4 primarily uses Upper Page 01h descriptors

fields.name: Bank 选择
fields.description: Bank Select 字节，配合 PageSelect 决定 Upper Memory 映射的 Bank
fields.description_en: Selects the bank mapped into Upper Memory together with PageSelect

fields.name: Page 选择
fields.description: Page Select 字节；切换后 Upper Memory 需遵守 tBPC 访问保持时间
fields.description_en: Selects the upper page; observe the tBPC hold time after switching

fields.name: 模块级监测量
fields.description: Lower 14-25 温度/电压/辅助监测量原始字节
fields.description_en: Lower 14-25 raw temperature, supply voltage and auxiliary monitor bytes

fields.name: 模块温度
fields.description: VDM 诊断监测量（DDM/VDM），实际页/偏移按模块 CMIS 版本核对
fields.description_en: Digital diagnostic monitor; exact page/offset depends on the module revision

fields.name: 模块供电电压
fields.description: 模块供电电压监测量
fields.description_en: Module supply voltage monitor

fields.name: Tx 光功率
fields.description: 按通道的发射光功率监测量
fields.description_en: Per-lane transmit optical power monitor

fields.name: Rx 光功率
fields.description: 按通道的接收光功率监测量
fields.description_en: Per-lane receive optical power monitor

fields.name: Lane1 Tx 偏置电流
fields.description: 通道 1 激光器偏置电流监测量
fields.description_en: Lane 1 laser bias current monitor

fields.name: Lane1 Rx LOS
fields.description: 接收信号丢失标志
fields.description_en: Receive loss-of-signal flag

fields.name: 高温告警阈值
fields.description: Page 02h 告警/预警阈值页的高温告警门限；应高于高温预警门限
fields.description_en: Page 02h high-temperature alarm threshold; must exceed the warning threshold
fields.spec_ref: OIF-CMIS-05.3 8.8 Thresholds / IETF YANG draft table 2

fields.name: 高温预警阈值
fields.description: Page 02h 高温预警门限
fields.description_en: Page 02h high-temperature warning threshold

fields.name: 低温预警阈值
fields.description: Page 02h 低温预警门限
fields.description_en: Page 02h low-temperature warning threshold

fields.name: 电压高告警阈值
fields.description: Page 02h 供电电压高告警门限
fields.description_en: Page 02h high supply-voltage alarm threshold

fields.name: VDM 观测冻结
fields.description: VDM Freeze 用于原子读取一组监测量
fields.description_en: VDM Freeze for an atomic snapshot of monitor values

fields.name: CDB 命令 ID (CMDID)
fields.description: 2 字节大端命令 ID；写入结束于 9Fh:129 的操作触发命令（OIF-CMIS-05.3 8.23.1/8.23.2）
fields.description_en: 2-byte big-endian command ID; a write ending at 9Fh:129 triggers the command

fields.name: EPL 长度
fields.description: 2 字节大端扩展载荷长度，最大 2048 字节（A0h-AFh 共 16 页 x 128 字节）
fields.description_en: 2-byte big-endian extended payload length, max 2048 bytes (16 pages x 128 bytes)

fields.name: LPL 长度
fields.description: 本地载荷有效字节数，最大 120
fields.description_en: Number of valid LPL bytes, maximum 120

fields.name: CDB 校验码
fields.description: 从 EPL 长度到 LPL 载荷的字节和按 256 取模为 0；本服务离线编排时自动计算
fields.description_en: Byte sum from EPL length through the LPL payload must be zero modulo 256; computed offline by this service

fields.name: 本地载荷 LPL
fields.description: 120 字节命令参数与短回复区；通过 CDB 操作界面编排，禁止直接写寄存器
fields.description_en: 120-byte argument and short-reply area; compose it in the CDB operations panel, direct writes are blocked

fields.name: 扩展载荷 EPL
fields.description: 最多 2048 字节，用于固件块等大数据；禁止远程写白名单委派
fields.description_en: Up to 2048 bytes for firmware blocks; MUST NOT be delegated to remote writers

fields.name: CDB 密码入口
fields.description: 4 字节密码；Linux ethtool 在固件命令前写入 0x7A。密码不由本服务持久化
fields.description_en: 4-byte password; Linux ethtool writes it at 0x7A before firmware commands. The service never persists it

fields.name: 命令最大完成时间
fields.description: CMD 0040h Module Features 回复中的最大命令执行时间（ms）
fields.description_en: Maximum command execution time in ms reported by CMD 0040h Module Features

fields.name: CDB 实例
fields.description: CMIS 支持多个 CDB 实例；Bank 选择决定当前实例
fields.description_en: CMIS supports multiple CDB instances; the bank select byte determines the active one

fields.name: 数据路径状态
fields.description: DPSM 状态：DPDeactivated / DPInit / DPActivated / DPTxTurnOn 等，逐字节偏移待核对
fields.description_en: DPSM state: DPDeactivated / DPInit / DPActivated / DPTxTurnOn; byte offset pending

fields.name: 配置错误码
fields.description: ConfigError 枚举，AppSel / DP 配置失败原因
fields.description_en: ConfigError enum describing AppSel / datapath failures

fields.name: AppSel Lane 1
fields.description: 0xAD 编码：高 4 bit = Application 编号(1-8)，低 4 bit = DataPath ID；0x00 未配置
fields.description_en: 0xAD encoding: A = Application (1-8), D = DataPath ID; 0x00 means unconfigured

fields.name: AppSel Lane 2
fields.description: Lane 2 的 Application / DataPath 选择
fields.description_en: Application / DataPath selection for lane 2

fields.name: AppSel Lane 3
fields.description: Lane 3 的 Application / DataPath 选择
fields.description_en: Application / DataPath selection for lane 3

fields.name: AppSel Lane 4
fields.description: Lane 4 的 Application / DataPath 选择
fields.description_en: Application / DataPath selection for lane 4

fields.name: 低功耗请求
fields.description: 模块级控制字段，软件强制模块进入 LowPwr；切换前后需遵守 Module State Machine 时序
fields.description_en: Software low-power request; observe the Module State Machine timing

fields.name: Tx 通道关闭
fields.description: Data Path 控制字段：关闭 Tx 输出
fields.description_en: Datapath control bit that disables the Tx output

fields.name: 数据路径初始化
fields.description: 触发 DPSM 从 DPDeactivated 向 DPActivated 转换

fields.name: Tx 均衡 Pre-cursor
fields.description: Staged Control Set 中的 SI 参数，需先 stage 再 apply
fields.description_en: Staged Control Set SI parameter, staged first then applied

fields.name: Tx 均衡 Post-cursor
fields.description: Staged Control Set 中的 SI 参数
fields.description_en: Staged Control Set SI parameter

fields.name: Tx 输出幅度
fields.description: Staged Control Set 中的输出幅度目标
fields.description_en: Output amplitude target in the Staged Control Set

fields.name: Tx CDR 使能
fields.description: Staged Control Set 的 TX CDR 使能位
fields.description_en: TX CDR enable bit in the Staged Control Set

fields.name: Rx CDR 使能
fields.description: Staged Control Set 的 RX CDR 使能位
fields.description_en: RX CDR enable bit in the Staged Control Set

fields.name: 环回模式
fields.description: 诊断页环回控制：None / Host-side / Media-side 等；具体枚举待原文核对
fields.description_en: Diagnostics loopback control; exact enumeration pending

fields.name: PRBS 发生器
fields.description: 诊断页 PRBS 码型发生器配置
fields.description_en: Diagnostics PRBS pattern generator

fields.name: PRBS 检查器
fields.description: 诊断页 PRBS 检查器与 BER 计数
fields.description_en: Diagnostics PRBS checker and BER counters

fields.name: 可调激光器频率
fields.description: C-CMIS / 可调激光器页的频率配置；仅相干 DCO 模块具备
fields.description_en: C-CMIS tunable laser frequency; coherent DCO modules only
